children: Recognition Underscores FTI Consulting and Compass Lexecon’s Global Expertise in Construction Advisory, Disputes, Digital Forensics, E-discovery, Forensic Accounting and Investigations
WASHINGTON, Sept. 15, 2026
-- FTI Consulting, Inc.
today announced that the firm and its Compass Lexecon subsidiary led the
Lexology Index Consulting Experts
list for the eleventh consecutive year, with 127 professionals recognized globally.

The list identifies leading consulting experts through an independent research process that combines qualitative market feedback with quantitative analysis of relevant data points, including recommendations from corporate counsel, clients, law firms and other market participants. Professionals from FTI Consulting and Compass Lexecon were selected based on the breadth of expertise across construction advisory, E-discovery, digital forensics, financial advisory and valuation and forensic accounting.
Several FTI Consulting and Compass Lexecon professionals were also named Global Elite Thought Leaders, a distinction for experts considered in the top 5% of practitioners worldwide. Experts include:

, Craig Earnshaw, Renato Fazzone, Veeral Gosalia, Brett Harrison, Stefan Heissner, Basil Imburgia, Thierry Linares, Patrick McGeehin, Boaz Moselle, James Nicholson, Karl Payeur, Andrew Rhodes, Ian Smith and Dawna Wright.

In addition to this recognition, Compass Lexecon recently topped the Lexology Index Competition 2026 list with the largest roster of featured consulting experts: 65 competition economists and future leaders were recognized globally. Nine FTI Consulting professionals were also recognized as competition economists on the list.
About FTI Consulting

FTI Consulting, Inc. is a leading global expert firm for organizations facing crisis and transformation, with more than 8,100 employees located in 32 countries and territories as of June 30, 2026. In certain jurisdictions, FTI Consulting’s services are provided through distinct legal entities that are separately capitalized and independently managed. The Company generated $3.8 billion in revenues during fiscal year 2025. More information can be found at https://www.fticonsulting.com.
About Compass Lexecon

Compass Lexecon is internationally recognized as a leading economic consulting firm with preeminent competition, finance, intellectual property, international arbitration, and energy practices. With more than 600 professionals in 23 offices around the world, Compass Lexecon offers a global perspective on economic matters. For the past two decades, Compass Lexecon has been ranked as one of the leading antitrust economics firms in the world by the Global Competition Review. To learn more about Compass Lexecon or to find one of our professionals, please visit www.compasslexecon.com.
